title: W1 fold overclaims: the flush call-site ordering (trigger BEFORE pending clear) is still unpinned by any test, yet code/test/PR-body comments declare it 'unit-pinned'
detail: Round-1 W1 flagged pending_any_plays + flush call-site ordering as unpinned. The fix pins predicate+trigger, but the ordering half is unverifiable: moving flush_maybe_duck(a) after a.pending = {} (or deleting it) fails no test — test_flush_duck_wiring drives the helper directly with hand-set pending, never audio_flush. The 'must fail here' / 'unit-pinned' claims are false; the spec's own honest framing ('flush integration is device-gated... manual verification') is contradicted by the shipped comments.
recommended_fix: Reword the audio.odin/test/PR-body comments to claim only predicate+trigger pinning and state ordering is inspection-only per the flush-half discipline — or make the ordering headless-observable (e.g., a pure flush-decision proc returning plays+duck before the device-gated half).

title: review-diff.txt header cites the wrong tree: claims '(8a082c8 vs 339e173)' and 'the record matching the shipped code', but its content is the r2 (c87bf05) tree
evidence:
"# Review diff for packet-plumber-v2-ambience (r1 review-swarm input)
# REGENERATED from the final tree (8a082c8 vs 339e173) after the r1 folds —
# the original snapshot reviewed by the swarm predated the duck-cap fix;
# this file is the record matching the shipped code."
detail: The file contains r2-only content (test_flush_duck_wiring, bed_duck_ratio, the bitexact/VAULT_SHA256 build script — 12 pending_any_plays hits); verified none of that exists at 8a082c8 (git show 8a082c8:app/audio/audio_test.odin has zero test_flush_duck_wiring; no bitexact in its build script). The regeneration header was written citing the pre-r2 head, so the record's provenance line is stale — the exact staleness class the header itself says it exists to fix.
recommended_fix: Update the header to the actual regenerated range (339e173..c87bf05) whenever review-diff.txt is regenerated; add the regeneration commit to the header at commit time.
